verdict.rationale: Fin's SDK exposes paginated list iterators and an API/MCP surface that could be scripted to loop over items, but there is no documented bulk-operation endpoint (e.g., bulk update conversations, bulk import tickets) or first-party guidance framed around bulk actions. missing for 10: explicit bulk-operation API/endpoint documentation, examples of batch processing many items in one call, and independent confirmation of bulk-scale usage.
